question: India's first wholly owned women's industrial park opened in March 2022 in Hyderabad. This park has been promoted by which organization in collaboration with the Government of Telangana?
solution:
The correct answer is "**FICCI Ladies Organisation**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The industrial park owned by the **FICCI Ladies Organization** is the first of its kind in the nation.
 
• On 50 acres of land in Sultanpur, which is close to **Patancheru**, this park was constructed.<
